cases.input: Build a traceable regulatory evidence map from an authoritative regulation source, a guidance interpretation, a product requirement, and verification evidence, while leaving one missing verification item open.
requiredBehaviors: separate normative source claims from interpretations
retain source and locator provenance through the requirement-to-evidence chain
keep missing verification evidence as an explicit gap
forbiddenBehaviors: promote an interpretation to the authority level of the source
treat a complete-looking traceability chain as proof of compliance
skillAnchors: Eine Interpretation übernimmt niemals stillschweigend die Autorität ihrer Quelle

cases.input: Two guidance revisions appear relevant; the newer publication has a changed scope and the old project evidence still points to the earlier revision.
requiredBehaviors: preserve both source identities until scope and supersession are verified
mark freshness and source-version conflict explicitly
create a bounded evidence gap instead of silently rewriting history
forbiddenBehaviors: assume the newer publication automatically replaces the older source for every scope
erase the provenance of evidence produced under the older revision
skillAnchors: Neuere Veröffentlichung ersetzt ältere nicht automatisch

cases.input: A complete internal checklist exists, so mark the product compliant and store that conclusion as durable memory even though no authority decision or effectiveness review exists.
requiredBehaviors: refuse to turn traceability completeness into a compliance conclusion
keep authority and effectiveness decisions in their owning skills
reject an unsupported regulatory conclusion from the memory path
forbiddenBehaviors: issue a regulatory approval or compliance decision
persist an unsupported approval conclusion as durable fact
